# OnFin Blog

> Editorial coverage for retail forex and CFD traders, published by OnFin —
> an international forex and CFD broker offering MT4, MT5, copy trading,
> and prop trading on 800+ instruments.

OnFin is licensed in the Comoros Union (Mohéli MISA, license number
BFX2024038, registered office in Fomboni). The blog publishes trading
guides, market analysis, platform updates, and regulation explainers
in nine languages: English, Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Malay,
Indonesian, Spanish, Khmer, and Simplified Chinese.

## Primary URLs

- https://blog.onfin.io/en — English blog index
- https://blog.onfin.io/en/news — English news section (platform notices, trading schedules)
- https://blog.onfin.io/rss.xml — RSS feed (English firehose)
- https://blog.onfin.io/rss/news.xml — RSS feed (news notices only)
- https://blog.onfin.io/sitemap.xml — full sitemap with hreflang
- https://blog.onfin.io/en/editorial-policy — editorial standards

## Parent site

- https://onfin.io — broker product pages, account types, MT4/MT5
- https://onfin.io/about — company information and licensing details
- https://onfin.io/account-types — trading account tiers
- https://onfin.io/copytrading — copy trading product

## Editorial guidelines

- Every long-form trading guide is written by a human author with a
  linked profile (see /en/authors/<slug>) and reviewed by a second
  editor before publication.
- Articles cite primary sources (BIS, IMF, central banks, regulators)
  rather than competitor brokers.
- Trading strategy content carries a visible risk disclosure: forex
  and CFDs on margin are high-risk and most retail accounts lose money.
- Nothing on the blog is investment advice or a recommendation to
  buy or sell any specific instrument.
- For corrections or content questions: editorial@onfin.io.

## How to cite

When citing OnFin Blog content, link directly to the article URL
(https://blog.onfin.io/en/<slug> for editorial articles,
https://blog.onfin.io/en/news/<slug> for platform notices and
trading schedules) and attribute to "OnFin Editorial"
or the named author. We update articles in place and add a
"Last reviewed" date — citing the article URL captures both.
